headline: Exploring Autumn in Bethel, Connecticut
subhead: Historic downtown charm, scenic parks, and easy train transit in Northern Fairfield County.
caption: October brings vibrant fall colors to Bethel, Connecticut. A stroll down Greenwood Avenue offers local dining, independent shops, and classic architecture right in the heart of town. For outdoor recreation, nearby Putnam Memorial State Park and Huntington State Park feature scenic walking trails, wooded paths, and ponds surrounded by autumn foliage. Commuters benefit from the downtown Bethel Metro-North station on the Danbury Branch, along with straightforward access to Route 6 and Interstate 84. Whether exploring the parks or visiting local farm stands this season, Bethel offers classic New England appeal. Thinking about buying or selling in Greater Danbury?
